改进奇数循环香农容量的下限Improved lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles

Nathaniel Itty Email: nathanielitty@gmail.com Worcester Polytechnic Institute Christopher D. Rosin Email: christopher.rosin@gmail.com Constructive Codes Chase Carstensen Worcester Polytechnic Institute Daniel Reichman Worcester Polytechnic Institute
摘要Abstract

香农容量The Shannon capacityΘ​(G)\Theta(G)图表的of a graphGG量化了在噪声信道上零误差传输信息的最大速率。它的下界为quantifies the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted with zero error over a noisy channel. It is lower bounded byα​(Gd)1/d\alpha(G^{d})^{1/d}对于任何for anydd, 其中, whereα​(Gd)\alpha(G^{d})是的独立数is the independence number of thedd的强大力量-th strong power ofGG。 我们构造独立的尺寸集. We construct independent sets of size134753134753 in C710C_{7}^{10}, 2190921909 in C116C_{11}^{6}, 和, and6253062530 in C136C_{13}^{6}，将这些图的香农容量的最著名下界改进为, improving the best known lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of these graphs toΘ​(C7)≥1347531/10>3.258020\Theta(C_{7})\geq 134753^{1/10}>3.258020, Θ​(C11)≥219091/6>5.289773\Theta(C_{11})\geq 21909^{1/6}>5.289773, 和, andΘ​(C13)≥625301/6>6.300109\Theta(C_{13})\geq 62530^{1/6}>6.300109。我们还改进了奇数循环的几个单独强幂的独立数的最著名下界，这些下界不会改进香农容量下界。这些结构是通过与大型语言模型 (LLM) 的迭代交互发现的，说明了 LLM 寻找显式组合结构的潜力。. We also improve the best known lower bounds on the independence numbers of several individual strong powers of odd cycles that do not improve the Shannon capacity lower bound. The constructions were discovered through iterative interactions with a Large Language Model (LLM), illustrating the potential of LLMs for finding explicit combinatorial constructions.

2.1 我们的方法Our approach

使用 ChatGPT-5.6 Sol Pro 通过标准 ChatGPT Web 界面进行搜索。对于每个实例，我们指定了周期长度、产品尺寸、我们已知的最佳结构以及改进所需的目标基数。该模型生成搜索程序，在其环境中执行它们，并以指定的格式返回结果独立集。Searches were conducted through the standard ChatGPT web interface using ChatGPT-5.6 Sol Pro. For each instance, we specified the cycle length, product dimension, best construction known to us, and target cardinality required for an improvement. The model generated search programs, executed them within its environment, and returned resulting independent sets in a specified format.

每次搜索都以详细的初始提示为中心，指定构造问题、所需的输出格式、需要改进的现有构造以及目标基数。在模型产生改进的结构后，我们使用简短的后续指令，要求其继续超出新获得的结果。Each search centered on a detailed initial prompt specifying the construction problem, the required output format, the existing construction to be improved, and the target cardinality. After the model produced an improved construction, we used brief follow-up instructions asking it to continue beyond the newly obtained result.

我们正在解决以下问题：We are working on the following problem:

“循环码”CC(n,k,m) 是字母表 {0,1,...,k-1} 上 m 个长度为 n 的码字的集合，使得任何一对不同的码字在 n 个位置中的至少一个位置上相差大于 1（循环取）。也就是说，对于长度为 n 的每两个码字 x 和 y，有一个位置 i 使得 min((x_i - y_i)%k, (y_i - x_i)%k)> 1。出于我们的目的，k<=15、n<=10 且 m< 200000。输出 CC(n,k,m)，每行一个码字，每个码字为 n 个空格分隔的整数，每个整数{0,1,...,k-1}。A "Cycle Code" CC(n,k,m) is set of m length-n codewords over the alphabet {0,1,...,k-1}, such that any pair of distinct codewords differ by more than 1 (taken circularly) in at least one of the n positions. That is, for every two codewords x and y of length n, there is a position i such that min((x_i - y_i)%k, (y_i - x_i)%k)> 1. For our purposes, k<=15, n<=10, and m< 200000. Output CC(n,k,m) with one codeword per line, with each codeword as n space-separated integers, each integer in {0,1,...,k-1}.

这本质上是循环的香农容量问题。对于 k=7，香农容量的最著名界限来自 CC(5,7,367) 的存在。我们对此进行了广泛的探索，我们不认为 367 可以增加。我们发现 k=7 且 n 在 {6,7,8,9} 中时有一些小的改进，但这些与改进香农容量的界限相去甚远。我们相信，提高 k=7 的香农容量界限的最佳机会将来自 n=10，其中通过 CC(5,7,367) 的简单组合，最知名的结果是 m=367*367=134689。求 CC(10,7,m)，m> 134689。This is essentially the Shannon capacity problem for cycles. For k=7, the best known bound on Shannon capacity is from the existence of CC(5,7,367). We have explored this extensively and we do not believe the 367 can be increased. We have found some small improvements for k=7 with n in {6,7,8,9}, but these are nowhere close to improving the bound on Shannon capacity. We believe the best opportunity for improving the Shannon capacity bound for k=7 will come from n=10, where the best known result is m=367*367=134689 by simple composition of CC(5,7,367). Find CC(10,7,m) with m> 134689.
